feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 10 June 2026 6:18am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

West 3 or 4, backing West or SW this evening, then gradually backing and increasing South or SW 5 or 6 tonight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, gradually building moderate tonight.


##Weather)##

Scattered showers today, rain and drizzle later tonight.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly moderate in showers, then moderate or poor in rain an drizzle later tonight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

South or SW 5 or 6, veering West or SW 4 or 5 later tomorrow morning, increasing West 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate.


##Weather)##

Rain and drizzle, turning patchy, then becoming generally fair later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor, becoming good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C

##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

##State of sea)##

##Weather)##

Mainly fair, possibly patchy rain for a time.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly moderate in any rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C

Nil.

##Visibility)##

Mostly good, but poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches later.
